note: Evidence coverage is honest: a screenshot is never promoted to a transcript, and a connected-app summary is not a complete Arena export.

evidence_levels.verbatim_transcript: Exact exported chat turns; raw bytes authoritative.
evidence_levels.verbatim_event_log: Exact hash-chained event/journal file; not a chat transcript.
evidence_levels.verbatim_source: Raw imported transcript/export bytes before normalization.
evidence_levels.repo_evidence: Git object, commit, branch, PR, workflow run, or checked-in file.
evidence_levels.screenshot_only: Partial visible screenshot image evidence; never a full transcript.
evidence_levels.state_ledger: Machine-readable state, coverage, session index or append-only JSONL ledger.
evidence_levels.operating_contract: Human-readable continuity contract, protocol, index or session note.
evidence_levels.archive_metadata: Generated archive metadata, hash index or integrity manifest.
evidence_levels.gap: Known missing source; explicitly not claimed as preserved.
